en.neutralHint: Fluent Dark · a neutral canvas with native typography. Choose a community design or import CSS in Community.
en.startingHint: Four credited designs. Preview before applying.
en.importPolicy: Only supported CSS and reviewed offline resources can be applied. Unsupported constructs produce a report.
en.libraryHint: Open a .dtheme, save edits or share a copy. One personal theme is active at a time; you can save multiple files.
en.variableHint: These edits keep the original design. Other properties remain in the preserved source.
en.sourceArtwork: Artwork and typography stay in the imported source. Use supported variables in Style.
en.importReviewHint: The source is kept in your portable configuration. Nothing in Discord changes until you choose a server and confirm Apply.
en.supportedImport: Compatible with the supported server adaptation model
en.noExternalResources: No external resources. No network requests are made.
en.licenseUnknown: No license text supplied. Check the author's redistribution terms before sharing.
en.serverAdaptation: Server pane adaptation by Theme Studio; original design and artwork by JACKPOT71.

en.independent: Independent community tool · not affiliated with Discord

ru.importReviewHint: Оригинал сохраняется в переносимой конфигурации. Discord изменится только после выбора сервера и подтверждения применения.
ru.supportedImport: Совместимо с поддерживаемой моделью адаптации для сервера
ru.noExternalResources: Нет внешних ресурсов. Сетевые запросы не выполняются.
ru.licenseUnknown: Текст лицензии отсутствует. Проверьте условия автора перед распространением.
